notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.notes:
New game mode: 60 seconds.
Reduced loading screen time.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: Challenge your skills in the online ranking!
notes.notes:
[b]We're excited to share the latest news with you. Introducing the new game mode: "60s". Master it by destroying as many targets as possible and earn your place in the global ranking.[/b]

Additionally, we're exploring the idea of rewarding top players. Keep an eye on our announcements for more details!

[b]In order to provide a faster and lighter experience, we've significantly reduced the screen loading time. Now, you'll only have a brief wait when opening the game.

Some improvements have been made to the "Double Shot" mode, while the "DefiantMotion" mode has been removed to enhance gameplay.[/b]

We remain committed to constantly offering new content to players, and we greatly appreciate everyone who has supported our game and project.

[b]Lune Play Studio Team.[/b]

notes.title: AIMSEX future plans
notes.notes:
With the AIMSEX release drawing closer, we'd like to share some of our future plans for the game at this initial stage:

Addition of more waifu characters.
Enhancements in character animations.
Introduction of new game modes, including a roulette feature.
We want to express our gratitude to everyone who has supported the game thus far. As a token of our appreciation, all DLCs will be completely free, and we're committed to continually improving your experience.

Lune Play Studio.
